api:
<ArcDiagram data={links} source={|l: &Link| l.from} target={|l: &Link| l.to} value={|l: &Link| l.weight} />
PropTypeDefault
dataone row per linkrequired
source, targetFn(&T) -> &str: node namesrequired
valueFn(&T) -> f64: arc width1. per link

Nodes sit on a line in the order they first appear, sized by their total weight. Arcs are half-circles above the line, flattened when they would not fit. Labels alternate between two rows when they would overlap.

Zoom: hold Ctrl (Cmd on macOS) and scroll, or pinch, to zoom about the pointer. Drag a rectangle to zoom into it, Shift and drag to pan, and double-click to reset.

examples.title: Shared scenes
examples.description: Nodes on a line, arcs sized by weight and coloured by source. Hover an arc or a node.
examples.code:
#[component]
fn characters() {
    let data = use_signal(scenes());
    rsx! { <ArcDiagram data={data} source={|e: &Edge| e.from} target={|e: &Edge| e.to} value={|e: &Edge| e.weight} class="h-80" /> }
}

examples.title: Twenty nodes
examples.code:
#[component]
fn crowded() {
    let labels = [
        "n01", "n02", "n03", "n04", "n05", "n06", "n07", "n08", "n09", "n10", "n11", "n12",
        "n13", "n14", "n15", "n16", "n17", "n18", "n19", "n20",
    ];
    let data = use_signal(
        (0..40u64)
            .map(|index| Edge {
                from: labels[(noise(index) * 20.) as usize % 20],
                to: labels[(noise(index + 500) * 20.) as usize % 20],
                weight: 1. + noise(index + 900) * 4.,
            })
            .collect::<Vec<_>>(),
    );
    rsx! { <ArcDiagram data={data} source={|e: &Edge| e.from} target={|e: &Edge| e.to} value={|e: &Edge| e.weight} class="h-80" /> }
}
